step1_analysis.circuit_type: Latch Fragment / Static Leakage Test Structure
step1_analysis.description: This circuit appears to be an incomplete extraction or a fragment of a soft-error-rate (SER) tolerant latch. Due to the static gate connections (e.g., XM5 gate tied to GND, XM4 gate tied to N0), it acts as a static circuit where node N0 is strongly pulled to VDD and N1 is floating near ground, making it suitable for measuring static leakage power.

paper_reference.title: Measurements and Analysis of SER-Tolerant Latch in a 90-nm Dual-VT CMOS Process

static_power.description: Static power consumption due to leakage currents in the steady state.

sky130_expected.calculation: XM5 is ON, pulling N0 to 1.8V. XM4 is OFF with Vds=-1.8V. Leakage current of XM4 is roughly 50pA. Power = 1.8V * 50pA = 90pW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The circuit is completely static with no direct DC path to ground except through OFF transistors.

sky130_expected.calculation: XM5 is a PMOS with its gate tied to GND (Vgs = -1.8V), so it is strongly ON and pulls N0 to VDD.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly pulled to VDD with no opposing pull-down network.

sky130_expected.calculation: N1 is floating and its voltage is determined by the leakage balance between XM2 (connected to 0.9V) and XM6 (connected to GND). Since XM6 has Vgs=0V and XM2 has Vgs<0V, XM6 is less OFF, pulling N1 close to 0V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Leakage to ground dominates over leakage from the 0.9V source.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the static operating point, node voltages, and leakage power of the latch fragment.
step3_testbench.spice:
* SER-Tolerant Latch Fragment Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9

XM1 GND GND LABEL_NET_0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 GND LABEL_NET_1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 GND N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 GND N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 GND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

.control
op
let static_power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print static_power
print v(N0)
print v(N1)

tran 1n 1u
meas tran v_n0_avg avg v(N0)
meas tran v_n1_avg avg v(N1)
quit
.endc
.end
